razonamiento: The whiteboard architecture depicts Snapchat's messaging and media delivery pipeline running on AWS. An EKS boundary encompasses five internal microservices: Gateway (GW), Media, Friend Graph, Messaging Core Service (MCS), and SnapDB (Snap's custom caching/abstraction layer over DynamoDB). The workflow splits into media ingestion (iOS sends snap via GW to Media, which stores in CloudFront/S3 and queries Friend Graph), metadata persistence (MCS writes to SnapDB, which writes to DynamoDB), message delivery to the recipient (MCS queries ElastiCache to locate the active persistent server connection in GW, and GW pushes the notification to Android), and media retrieval (Android fetches the snap from CloudFront).
nombre: Snapchat Messaging and Media Delivery Architecture

nodes.name: SnapDB
nodes.notes: Custom database abstraction layer handling transactions, TTL, and ephemeral data

nodes.notes: 400 TB metadata store; nightly scans process 2B rows/min
